input: After enabling LPDDR5 deep sleep (DSM) on my MediaTek platform, system-level leakage current is 15 mA higher than spec during display-off idle. The PMIC rail for VDDQ shows 0 mV as expected, but the CA/DQ termination resistors on the PHY side don't appear to be tri-stated. How do I trace whether the DDR PHY power island is failing to fully collapse, and which Linux DFI stress and devfreq PM hooks should I instrument to confirm DSM entry?
